source:
version: "1"
kind: miner
id: 9000003
slug: truth-beacon-publicnode-finalized
name: PublicNode Beacon REST, finalized validator effective balance (truth source)
description: >
  Ethereum consensus-layer state from the keyless PublicNode Beacon REST API (the standard beacon-node API).
  effective_balance is data.validator.effective_balance, in gwei, read from the finalized state.
base_url: https://ethereum-beacon-api.publicnode.com
auth:
  type: none
endpoints:
  - path: /eth/v1/beacon/states/finalized/validators/{validator_index}
    external_path: /eth/v1/beacon/states/finalized/validators/{validator_index}
    method: GET
    description: Read data.validator.effective_balance (gwei) for one beacon validator index from the finalized state.
    intents: [VALIDATOR_PERFORMANCE_VERIFY_GENERAL]
    params:
      path:
        required:
          - name: validator_index
            type: integer
            intents: [VALIDATOR_PERFORMANCE_VERIFY_GENERAL]
            description: Ethereum beacon validator index, integer from 0 to 1000000000.
intent_mapping:
  VALIDATOR_PERFORMANCE_VERIFY_GENERAL:
    endpoint: /eth/v1/beacon/states/finalized/validators/{validator_index}
    input:
      validator_index:
        from: validator_index
    output:
      effective_balance:
        path: data.validator.effective_balance
        unit: gwei
semantics:
  supported_intents: [VALIDATOR_PERFORMANCE_VERIFY_GENERAL]
